Metrics.Name: m365.teams_usage.activity.users
Metrics.Description: Daily Teams users per activity in the D30 report, by days before its latest Report Date. Activity groups overlap.

Metrics.Name: m365.teams_usage.names_concealed
Metrics.Description: Whether Microsoft Graph usage reports conceal names (1: on, 0: off, absent: unknown).

Metrics.Name: m365.teams_usage.report_refresh_timestamp
Metrics.Description: UTC midnight of the source Report Refresh Date, in Unix seconds, for the D7 device and D30 user activity counts reports. Absent if not established.

Metrics.Name: teams.device_usage.users
Metrics.Description: Users who used each Teams client platform in the D7 report. A user can use more than one platform.
